description: Defines the Toolchain class used for managing build toolchains in a project, including tool retrieval, setup, dependencies, and configuration propagation.

classes.name: Toolchain
classes.description: Represents a build toolchain with methods for tool management, dependencies, and configuration.

methods.name: GetTool
methods.description: Retrieves a tool by name, returns null if not defined.

methods.name: GetToolAsGeneral
methods.description: Retrieves a tool as a GeneralTool by name.

methods.name: GetToolAsC
methods.description: Retrieves a tool as a CTool by name.

methods.name: GetToolAsRust
methods.description: Retrieves a tool as a RustTool by name.

methods.name: GetToolAsBuiltin
methods.description: Retrieves a tool as a BuiltinTool by name.

methods.name: SetTool
methods.description: Sets a tool in the toolchain.

methods.name: ToolchainSetupComplete
methods.description: Finalizes setup after all tools are configured.

methods.name: GetToolForSourceType
methods.description: Returns the tool for a specific source file type.

methods.name: GetToolForTargetFinalOutput
methods.description: Returns the tool that produces the final output for a target.
